readerCopy.body: An obligation looks different once it becomes obvious that the arrangement works only because one person keeps absorbing the part nobody else wants. When Saturn conjoins Lilith, duty and refusal intensify together, making a role, promise, contract, or responsibility harder to carry under the old terms. There may be less tolerance for responsibility that only works because one person keeps taking the extra work, cost, or consequence. The commitment can still matter without every condition attached to it deserving to survive. A fairer arrangement names who does what and what happens when they cannot keep carrying it.
